identity.name: Froggatt-Nielsen flavon-portal right-handed-neutrino freeze-out dark matter
identity.short_description: An effective Froggatt-Nielsen model where a Z_2-odd lightest right-handed neutrino freezes out through scalar and pseudoscalar flavon portals.

annihilation_channels: N^1 N^1 -> Standard Model fermion pairs
interactions.cp_structure: pseudoscalar portal emphasized; scalar flavon also present
dark_sector_couplings: N^1 N^1 s coupling set by the FN charge and v_phi
N^1 N^1 a coupling set by the FN charge and v_phi
flavon couplings to SM fermions fixed by FN charges and fermion masses
interactions.flavor_structure: Flavor couplings are controlled by chosen Froggatt-Nielsen charge assignments.
interaction_operators: higher-dimensional Froggatt-Nielsen Yukawa operators
Majorana right-handed-neutrino mass operators involving the flavon
standard_model_targets: Standard Model fermions through Froggatt-Nielsen-suppressed flavon couplings
